expected_behavioral_quality: Immediately shifts to a concise format when asked. Subsequent responses are noticeably shorter without losing useful content. Does not explain why it was verbose or justify the previous style. Just adapts.

Mohegan Sun is one of the most impressive casino resorts in the Western Hemisphere, spanning 3.3 million square feet in Uncasville, Connecticut. The property features two distinct hotel towers—the Sky Tower and the Earth Tower—which together offer about 1,600 luxury rooms and suites designed to be a peaceful retreat.

The Earth Tower is our newest addition, featuring a very contemporary design and cutting-edge amenities. If you prefer the flagship experience, the Sky Tower houses our Deluxe rooms, which are a spacious 450 square feet and include floor-to-ceiling windows to take in the views.

An insider detail you might appreciate is that the resort's design actually reflects the Mohegan Tribe's cultural heritage, with the architecture and decor throughout the hotel lobbies telling the story of the people who own and operate the property. After you get settled into your room, you'll be just steps away from over 40 different restaurants ranging from casual bites to fine dining. Are you planning your visit for a weekend stay or a mid-week trip?
